how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MGU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the MGU Assistant Professor posts is 15 August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor posts at MGU?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University (MGU) has announced a total of 24 vacancies for the Assistant Professor positions across various schools and departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for the Assistant Professor posts is as per the norms set by the University Grants Commission (UGC).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Professor posts is 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Professor posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for MGU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for this recruitment drive must be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for MGU Assistant Professor jobs?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor positions at Mahatma Gandhi University will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Mahatma Gandhi University located?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University is located in Kottayam, Kerala, with the pincode 686560.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor positions at Mahatma Gandhi University are on a contract basis.
